g.text: Governance, risk and compliance platform — Processes and Capabilities

One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Scan code and dependencies for security defects
Qualify, price, and contract servicing client
Analyze complaint signal for conduct risk
Test credit decisions and pricing for fair lending
Grant or decline an architecture exception
Evaluate and select a technology or platform
Maintain cardholder data scope and evidence
Onboard and oversee ISO or agent
Manage issue and remediation to closure
